summary: Round-8 testing for AbodeOps: Payment Reconciliation (/api/reconcile + /api/jobs/{id}/mark-paid + /api/metrics payroll_owed gating) and BETA launch pricing (Premium $19.99, Business $39.99). Re-seeded demo data first. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_round8_reconcile_beta.py with 11 tests — ALL 11/11 PASSED. Verified: GET /api/reconcile returns the documented shape {totals{payroll_owed,payroll_paid,revenue_total,revenue_today}, payroll_by_cleaner[{cleaner_id,name,total_owed,total_paid,jobs[]}], revenue_by_job[{job_id,title,revenue,pay,paid,...}]}; cleaner role -> 403; Casey Cleaner group present with total_owed>0 and 4 completed jobs; mark-paid 403 for cleaner / 404 for unknown job. End-to-end: as owner pre-flip payroll_owed=$300 and /metrics payroll_owed=$300; POST /api/jobs/demojob_5/mark-paid {paid:true} returned {ok:true,paid:true}; post-flip reconcile totals shifted owed=$210 / paid=$90 and /api/metrics payroll_owed=$210 (drop of exactly $90 = demojob_5 pay 3h*$30). Flipping back to paid:false restored owed=$300. Billing: POST /api/billing/checkout {tier:'pro',redirect_url} and {tier:'business',redirect_url} both return checkout_url (https Stripe URL); invalid tier 'free' -> 422. Source assertion confirms TIER_PRICING = {'pro':1999,'business':3999}. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): (1) Owner logs in -> Home -> tapped Command Center card -> /operations -> tapped metric-payroll -> /reconcile?tab=payroll. Summary boxes show $300 Owed to cleaners / $0 Already paid. Casey Cleaner card (testID cleaner-user_52caf676c159) expanded to reveal 4 jobs each with a pay-<jobid> button (pay-demojob_5, pay-demojob_4, pay-job_e9e5f788632e, pay-job_e238bdf9aaa9). Tapped pay-demojob_5 -> button flipped from 'Mark paid' to 'Paid' (paidBtn style), Casey header updated to '$90 paid' + '$210 owed', summary box dropped to $210 Owed / $90 Already paid. (2) Switched to Revenue tab (testID tab-revenue) -> per-job list shows 4 revenue rows (Move-out deep clean $90 Payroll due, Condo refresh $90 Settled, TEST_feedback_job x2 $60 Payroll due each), summary boxes $180 Revenue today / $300 Total revenue. (3) From /operations tapped metric-revenue -> deep-linked /reconcile?tab=revenue with Revenue tab active. (4) /subscription page: beta banner '🚀 Beta launch pricing — locked in for your first 3 months...' visible; Premium card (testID tier-pro) shows '$19.99' /mo with '$49' as struck-through (computed style textDecoration: line-through confirmed) plus 'BETA PRICE' chip; Business card (testID tier-business) shows '$39.99' /mo with '$99' struck-through, 'BETA PRICE' chip AND 'MOST POPULAR' ribbon. Tapped upgrade-pro -> navigated to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... Stripe Sandbox page displays 'Subscribe to AbodeOps Pro — US$19.99 per month'. Tapped upgrade-business -> Stripe Sandbox page displays 'Subscribe to AbodeOps Business — US$39.99 per month'. BETA pricing flows end-to-end through Stripe checkout sessions. No React Native red screens or new console errors. Only carry-over warnings (shadow* deprecation, expo SDK drift) — same as iter-7.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py L36 TIER_PRICING = {'pro':1999,'business':3999} ✓ matches BETA spec. Make sure the matching Stripe Price/Lookup keys (e.g. abodeops_pro_monthly_1999, abodeops_business_monthly_3999) are configured in the Stripe dashboard — the existing checkout flow used dynamic price_data so it currently works regardless, but if you switch to fixed price IDs the keys must exist.

/app/backend/server.py L1263-1271 mark-paid: correctly enforces poster/admin authz and toggles payroll_paid + paid_at. Consider also blocking when status != 'completed' so an in-progress job can't be marked paid; today nothing prevents that. Not blocking — reconcile only iterates completed jobs anyway.

/app/backend/server.py L1273-1316 reconcile: totals math is correct and revenue_by_job is sorted desc by completed_at, payroll_by_cleaner sorted desc by total_owed. payroll_by_cleaner.jobs[].hours uses logged_hours which is 0 for the two TEST_feedback_job seeds → UI shows '0h · $60' which is harmless but a tiny data-quality smell.
/app/backend/server.py L1273-1316 reconcile does NOT exclude cancelled jobs explicitly — the find() already filters status='completed' so cancelled are excluded by query. Good.

/app/frontend/app/reconcile.tsx L79-82 'Mark paid' button toggles optimistically by calling load() after mark-paid — works, but a 500 from the API would silently leave the UI unchanged (no error toast). Consider surfacing the err.message inline like subscription.tsx does.

/app/frontend/app/subscription.tsx L104-111 originalPrice rendering uses textDecoration: line-through (confirmed via computed style). The orig and current prices stack vertically inside the priceTag — looks correct on 390 viewport; would suggest a small horizontal layout test on tablet widths.
/app/frontend/src/theme.ts L51 BETA_NOTE copy is good. Consider including the absolute prices ('locked-in $19.99 / $39.99 for 3 months') for transparency.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 round-8 tests). /reconcile shape+RBAC, mark-paid authz/404/toggle+metrics drop, billing checkout pro+business BETA pricing, TIER_PRICING constant assertion — all green.
